info.title: occtl
info.description: occtl, the OmniCore command line: sign in to an OmniCore server, manage plugins, schema and entities, and deploy OmniCore to Kubernetes (through the Kubernetes API) or Docker from an OmniCoreDeployment file. Install with: dotnet tool install --global OmniCore.Cli

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: occtl: the OmniCore command line. Sign in, manage plugins, web parts, schema, entities, views and resources, and deploy OmniCore.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --context
options.description: The context (server) to use; default: the current one (occtl config use-context).

options.name: --output
options.description: Output format: table, json or yaml. [default: Table]

commands.name: login
commands.description: Sign in to a database server. Uses the server's identity provider in a browser by default (authorization code + PKCE). The sign-in is saved, encrypted, and renewed automatically.

options.name: --name
options.description: The context name to save it as. Default: the server's host (and port).

options.name: --password
options.description: Sign in with a username and password instead of a browser. [default: False]

options.name: --username
options.description: The username for --password (prompted for if omitted).

options.name: --password-stdin
options.description: Read the password from standard input (for scripts). [default: False]

options.name: --dev
options.description: Development servers only: sign in with a development token for this subject (default dev-admin).

arguments.name: SERVER
arguments.description: The database server, e.g. https://omnicore.example.com. Default: the current context's server.

commands.name: logout
commands.description: Forget the saved sign-in for a context (the context itself is kept).

commands.name: whoami
commands.description: Show who you are signed in as, and your roles and permissions.

commands.name: config
commands.description: Manage contexts: the OmniCore servers occtl knows, and which one is current.

commands.name: get-contexts
commands.description: List contexts (saved servers).

commands.name: current-context
commands.description: Show the current context.

commands.name: use-context
commands.description: Make a context the current one.

commands.name: delete-context
commands.description: Delete a context and its saved sign-in.

commands.name: plugin
commands.description: Manage plugins.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List installed plugins.

commands.name: get
commands.description: Show a plugin: its classes and triggers, state, warnings and recent errors.

commands.name: install
commands.description: Upload an .opl plugin: installs it (or replaces the same id) and adds the schema in its manifest.

commands.name: enable
commands.description: Enable a plugin.

commands.name: disable
commands.description: Disable a plugin.

commands.name: remove
commands.description: Remove a plugin (its files are deleted; schema it added stays).

commands.name: sdk
commands.description: Download the OmniCore.PlugIn NuGet package, to build plugins with.

options.name: --output-dir
options.description: Where to save it (default: the current folder). [default: .]

commands.name: webpart
commands.description: Make and manage web part packages (.owp) for dashboards.

commands.name: new
commands.description: Make a new web part project: the package (manifest, module, stylesheet, settings schema), the harness dashboard, a test, and package.json with the web part SDK. Needs no server.

options.name: --publisher
options.description: Your publisher name: lower-case letters and digits (such as contoso). Web part ids start with it.

options.name: --id
options.description: The package id (default: <publisher>.<folder name>).

options.name: --part
options.description: The first web part's short name, such as kpi-tile (default: the folder's name). Its id is <publisher>.<part> and its element <publisher>-<part>.

options.name: --name
options.description: The first web part's display name (default: from --part).

options.name: --sdk-version
options.description: The npm version range of @eon.software/omnicore-webpart-sdk (default: 0.x, the newest preview when installed).

options.name: --visual-studio
options.description: Also make a .csproj that packs the .owp on build, to add to a Visual Studio solution. [default: False]

options.name: --force
options.description: Write into a folder that isn't empty, replacing files with the same names. [default: False]

arguments.name: FOLDER
arguments.description: The folder to make the project in. It must be new or empty, unless --force.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List the installed web part packages, every version, and their web parts.

commands.name: install
commands.description: Upload an .owp web part package: installs that version (or replaces the same version's files).

commands.name: remove
commands.description: Remove one version of a web part package. Dashboards that use it show the part as missing.

commands.name: schema
commands.description: Show and change the schema: fields, option sets, perspectives and relationships.

commands.name: get
commands.description: Show the whole schema (fields, perspectives, relationships and option sets).

commands.name: field
commands.description: Fields: the values entities hold.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List fields.

commands.name: set
commands.description: Define a field, or change its display name, description and (for an Options field) option set.

options.name: --type
options.description: Text, Integer, Decimal, Boolean, DateTime, Reference, Json or Options. Required for a new field; it cannot change.

options.name: --option-set
options.description: An Options field's option set: the key/value pairs it offers. Required for a new Options field.

options.name: --display-name
options.description: The name forms show.

options.name: --description
options.description: A description.

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: The field's system name (the JSON key).

commands.name: delete
commands.description: Delete a field no perspective uses: its values are removed from every entity, with progress shown.

options.name: --no-wait
options.description: Start the deletion and return; follow it with the maker site or by running delete again. [default: False]

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: The field's system name (the JSON key).

commands.name: optionset
commands.description: Option sets: key/value pairs that Options fields offer.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List option sets.

commands.name: get
commands.description: Show an option set and its key/value pairs.

commands.name: set
commands.description: Define an option set, or change its display name, description or options.

options.name: --option
options.description: A key/value pair, key=Value: the key is stored, the value shown. Repeat it for each option, in order; it replaces the whole list.

options.name: --display-name
options.description: The name forms show.

options.name: --description
options.description: A description.

commands.name: delete
commands.description: Delete an option set no field uses.

commands.name: perspective
commands.description: Perspectives (interfaces): named, ordered sets of fields.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List perspectives (interfaces).

commands.name: get
commands.description: Show a perspective.

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: The perspective's system name (or id, for get).

commands.name: set
commands.description: Define a perspective, or change its display name, description and fields.

options.name: --display-name
options.description: The name forms show.

options.name: --description
options.description: A description.

options.name: --fields
options.description: The perspective's fields in form order, comma-separated; end a name with ! to require it, e.g. "accountNumber!,firstName,email". Replaces the list.

options.name: --add-field
options.description: Add a field (end with ! to require it). Repeatable.

options.name: --remove-field
options.description: Remove a field. Repeatable.

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: The perspective's system name (or id, for get).

commands.name: relationship
commands.description: Relationships between perspectives, enforced on every change.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List relationships.

commands.name: set
commands.description: Define or replace a relationship (checked against existing data).

options.name: --from
options.description: The first end: Perspective:One|Many[:referenceField], e.g. Order:Many:customer.

options.name: --to
options.description: The second end, e.g. Customer:One.

options.name: --display-name
options.description: The name forms show.

options.name: --description
options.description: A description.

commands.name: delete
commands.description: Delete a relationship (its references are no longer checked).

commands.name: solution
commands.description: Export and import solutions: files of schema and designs to move between OmniCores (System Admin).

commands.name: list
commands.description: List the solutions applied here and the solution files made here.

commands.name: catalog
commands.description: List what can go in a solution, by kind, with what each object needs.

commands.name: export
commands.description: Make a solution file (.ocs) of the objects chosen and what they need, and download it.

options.name: --display-name
options.description: The name to show (default: the name).

options.name: --version
options.description: The solution's version (default 1.0.0).

options.name: --description
options.description: What the solution is for.

options.name: --include
options.description: What to put in it, as kind:key (fields:creditLimit, perspectives:Customer, webParts:acme.map@1.0.0), or kind:* for all of a kind. Repeat it. What each object needs is added too.

options.name: --output-dir
options.description: Where to save the file (default: the current folder). [default: .]

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: The solution's name: a letter, then letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'.

commands.name: import
commands.description: Apply a solution file: creates or updates each object, carrying on past any that can't be, and reports how each went.

options.name: --report
options.description: Save the import's HTML report here too.

commands.name: backup
commands.description: Back up and restore the whole database (System Admin).

commands.name: list
commands.description: List the backups kept on the server, newest first.

commands.name: create
commands.description: Back up the whole database (but the log files) on the server. Requests wait while the files are copied.

options.name: --output-dir
options.description: Also download the backup into this folder.

commands.name: download
commands.description: Download a backup kept on the server.

options.name: --output-dir
options.description: Where to save it (default: the current folder). [default: .]

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: The backup's name, as backup list shows it.

commands.name: restore
commands.description: Replace ALL of the server's data with a backup's (a file, or one kept on the server). Requests wait meanwhile.

options.name: --yes
options.description: Do not ask for confirmation: the restore replaces ALL of the server's data. [default: False]

arguments.name: BACKUP
arguments.description: A backup file (.obk), or the name of a backup kept on the server.

commands.name: entity
commands.description: Read, query and delete entities.

commands.name: get
commands.description: Show an entity.

commands.name: query
commands.description: Query entities.

options.name: --impl
options.description: Perspectives the entities must have: Contact,Customer (all of) or Customer|Supplier (any of).

options.name: --where
options.description: A filter in the OmniCore query language, e.g. "creditLimit > 1000 & city = 'Leeds'".

options.name: --order
options.description: Sort keys, e.g. "-creditLimit, lastName".

options.name: --select
options.description: Fields to return, comma-separated.

options.name: --take
options.description: Page size (default 50). [default: 50]

options.name: --skip
options.description: Entities to skip (paging).

commands.name: delete
commands.description: Delete an entity.

commands.name: resource
commands.description: Manage resources: files such as scripts, images and assemblies stored in the database.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List resources: their paths, sizes, types, who can read them and who uploaded them.

arguments.name: PREFIX
arguments.description: Only paths that start with this, ignoring case, such as images/.

commands.name: get
commands.description: Download a resource to a file.

options.name: --file
options.description: Where to save it (default: its file name, in the current folder).

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite the file if it exists. [default: False]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: The resource's path: its folders and file name, such as images/logo.png.

commands.name: put
commands.description: Upload a file as a resource, creating or replacing it. A path ending in / gets the file's name.

options.name: --access
options.description: Who can read it: public (anyone, no sign-in) or signed-in. Default: signed-in for a new resource; a replaced one keeps its setting.

options.name: --content-type
options.description: The content type, used only when the server doesn't know the file's extension.

options.name: --create-only
options.description: Fail if the resource already exists, rather than replacing it. [default: False]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: The resource's path: its folders and file name, such as images/logo.png.

commands.name: access
commands.description: Change who can read a resource. Needs its uploader or a System Admin.

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: The resource's path: its folders and file name, such as images/logo.png.

commands.name: remove
commands.description: Delete a resource, and any folders it leaves empty. Needs its uploader or a System Admin.

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: The resource's path: its folders and file name, such as images/logo.png.

commands.name: view
commands.description: Manage views: sortable, searchable tables over one perspective each.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List views: their perspectives, columns, and any problems after a schema change.

options.name: --perspective
options.description: The perspective the view lists (name or id). Required for a new view; with list, only its views.

commands.name: get
commands.description: Show a view: its perspective, columns, filter and sort.

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: The view's name: letters, digits, '.', '-' and '_', starting with a letter.

commands.name: set
commands.description: Create a view, or change one: options left out keep their current values.

options.name: --perspective
options.description: The perspective the view lists (name or id). Required for a new view; with list, only its views.

options.name: --columns
options.description: The columns in order, comma-separated: a field, or field=Heading. Required for a new view; replaces them all.

options.name: --display-name
options.description: The name people see.

options.name: --description
options.description: What the view is for.

options.name: --filter
options.description: A fixed $where over the perspective's fields, e.g. "creditLimit > 0". "" removes it.

options.name: --order
options.description: The default sort, e.g. "-creditLimit, lastName". "" removes it.

options.name: --page-size
options.description: Rows per page, 1 to 1,000.

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: The view's name: letters, digits, '.', '-' and '_', starting with a letter.

commands.name: delete
commands.description: Delete a view. Needs Manage on its perspective.

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: The view's name: letters, digits, '.', '-' and '_', starting with a letter.

commands.name: show
commands.description: Show a view's table: search it, sort it and page through it.

options.name: --search
options.description: Words that must each appear in one of the view's Text columns, ignoring case.

options.name: --order
options.description: Sort by the view's columns, e.g. "-creditLimit" (default: the view's sort).

options.name: --where
options.description: A $where over the view's columns.

options.name: --skip
options.description: Rows to skip.

options.name: --take
options.description: Rows to show (default: the view's page size).

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: The view's name: letters, digits, '.', '-' and '_', starting with a letter.

commands.name: deploy
commands.description: Deploy OmniCore to Kubernetes (through the Kubernetes API) or Docker, from an OmniCoreDeployment file.

commands.name: init
commands.description: Write a deployment file with every setting explained, to edit and apply.

options.name: --file
options.description: The OmniCoreDeployment file (default: omnicore.yaml). [default: omnicore.yaml]

options.name: --target
options.description: kubernetes or docker. [default: kubernetes]

options.name: --identity
options.description: omnicore (deploy OmniCore.Identity) or external (e.g. Entra ID). [default: omnicore]

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite an existing file. [default: False]

commands.name: apply
commands.description: Create or update the deployment described by the file.

options.name: --file
options.description: The OmniCoreDeployment file (default: omnicore.yaml). [default: omnicore.yaml]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print what would be applied (Kubernetes objects or the compose file) without changing anything. [default: False]

options.name: --no-wait
options.description: Do not wait for the servers to be ready. [default: False]

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Minutes to wait for the servers to be ready (default 5). [default: 5]

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show the deployment's workloads and whether its servers answer.

options.name: --file
options.description: The OmniCoreDeployment file (default: omnicore.yaml). [default: omnicore.yaml]

commands.name: delete
commands.description: Remove the deployment. Data is kept unless --purge is given.

options.name: --file
options.description: The OmniCoreDeployment file (default: omnicore.yaml). [default: omnicore.yaml]

options.name: --purge
options.description: Also delete the data volumes (all entities, the directory, plugins) and the bootstrap secret. Cannot be undone. [default: False]

options.name: --yes
options.description: Do not ask for confirmation of --purge. [default: False]
